text: Eligible landholding farmer families receive income support of Rs 6,000 per year, paid in three equal instalments of Rs 2,000 directly into their bank account.
पात्र भूमिधारक किसान परिवारों को प्रति वर्ष 6,000 रुपये की आय सहायता मिलती है, जो 2,000 रुपये की तीन समान किस्तों में सीधे बैंक खाते में दी जाती है।
All landholding farmer families with cultivable land in their name are eligible. Income tax payers, institutional landholders and serving or retired government employees are excluded.
જેમના નામે ખેતીલાયક જમીન છે તેવા તમામ જમીનધારક ખેડૂત પરિવારો પાત્ર છે. આવકવેરો ભરનારા અને સરકારી કર્મચારીઓ પાત્ર નથી.
Provides health cover of up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year for hospital treatment at empanelled public and private hospitals, cashless and paperless.
सूचीबद्ध सरकारी और निजी अस्पतालों में इलाज के लिए प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष 5 लाख रुपये तक का स्वास्थ्य कवर, बिना नकद और बिना कागज़ के।
Documents needed: Aadhaar card, ration card or proof of family, and a mobile number. The Ayushman card is issued after verification at a hospital help desk or Common Service Centre.
An adult woman from a poor household who does not already have an LPG connection in the household can apply for a free LPG connection.
गरीब परिवार की वयस्क महिला, जिसके घर में पहले से एलपीजी कनेक्शन नहीं है, मुफ्त एलपीजी कनेक्शन के लिए आवेदन कर सकती है।
A parent or legal guardian can open a Sukanya Samriddhi account for a girl child below 10 years of age at a post office or authorised bank.
Visit a post office or authorised bank branch, fill the account opening form, and submit the girl's birth certificate and the guardian's identity and address proof with the first deposit.
પોસ્ટ ઓફિસ અથવા અધિકૃત બેંક શાખામાં જઈને ખાતું ખોલવાનું ફોર્મ ભરો અને પ્રથમ જમા સાથે દીકરીનું જન્મ પ્રમાણપત્ર અને વાલીનો ઓળખ તથા સરનામાનો પુરાવો આપો.
